privacy.title: Privacy Policy
paragraphs: Amark (“we”) provides an early-access planner builder. This short policy explains what we collect while the product is in beta.
Account data: when you sign in with Google we store your user ID, email, display name, and photo URL so we can identify your account and manage early access.
Product data: planner templates, page metadata, uploaded artwork, and custom fonts are stored so you can edit and export your planners. Artwork and fonts may be hosted with our file-storage provider.
Waitlist: if you join the waitlist we store the email you submit, a pending status, locale, and where you signed up from.
Analytics: we use Firebase Analytics to understand product usage (for example page views and key actions). This helps us improve Amark.
We do not sell your personal data. We use providers (such as Google Firebase, Vercel, and UploadThing) only to run and host the service.
You can ask about your data or request deletion by contacting support. We will respond within a reasonable time for this early-access stage.

terms.title: Terms of Use
paragraphs: Amark is an early-access product offered as-is. Features may change, and availability is not guaranteed.
You must be allowed to use the designs, images, and fonts you upload. You keep ownership of your artwork; you grant us a limited license to store and process it so the service can work.
The editor is designed for laptop and desktop screens. Mobile and small viewports are not fully supported yet.
Generated PDFs are for your own use or sale under your responsibility. Amark is not a print shop and does not guarantee commercial print results.
Do not abuse the service, attempt to bypass access controls, or interfere with other users’ data.
We may suspend or revoke early access if needed to protect the product or other users. These terms may be updated as Amark evolves.
